Convert any amount between 30+ world currencies with live exchange rates. Pick source and target currencies, convert instantly, and see the rate and last update date.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter an amount.
  2. Choose the From and To currencies.
  3. Tap Convert (or just change the amount) to see the result.
  4. Use Swap to flip the currencies; rates are cached per base currency.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do the exchange rates come from?

Live rates are fetched from /api/rates. If the fetch fails you will see a clear error message and the last cached result stays visible.

Are rates refreshed automatically?

The converted amount is updated whenever the rate loads. Fetched rates are cached per base currency so switching back is instant.

What is the current USD to PKR rate?

The USD -> PKR rate shown comes straight from the live feed, so it reflects the latest available market rate.
